analysis_role: post-hoc diagnostic of one fixed final endpoint; never training or model selection

policy.directions: 64 fixed seeded Gaussian unit vectors and exact negative pairs, reused at all radii

source_metadata.scale_source: saved symbolic-export normalization; copied without any fit

coordinates.lift: last delta is exactly zero; all pi, p and q retained

summary.participation_definition: squared right-eigenvector physical-readout amplitudes in saved physical scales; not biorthogonal participation factors or physical energy fractions

lyapunov.equation: A.T @ P + P @ A = -I, using the fixed smaller-step scaled Jacobian

limitations: Numerical linearization and negative real parts are not a nonlinear stability-region certificate.
Numerical eigenvalues of P are a positivity diagnostic; validated bounds and full-field region conditions are still needed for a nonlinear region/invariance certificate.
The 640 fixed ROM-only directional samples can expose failures but cannot prove decrease between samples.
No original 13-mode matching, L2 success, global stability, or high-order-system guarantee is asserted.
